Oviedo votes Nov 2: neighbor check-in shift

  • Sat, Jan 30 · 9:30 am to 12:30 pm
  • Center Lake Park, Oviedo · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
PKS+1316 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Knock doors in pairs, help neighbors get their mail ballots sorted, and get to know your city's 2027 election.

What's the plan

Oviedo's next city election, for mayor and one city council seat, is Tue, Nov 2, 2027. Today we knock doors in pairs with two simple asks: did you know mail-ballot requests from before Nov 3, 2026 ended Dec 31, and is your registration up to date? Neighbors take care of it themselves on the official site; we bring the heads-up and a QR code. City races are open to every voter in the city, whatever their party, so this shift is about voting, not about a candidate. Short training at the start, a buddy for everyone, done by lunch.

We don't collect signatures, forms or anyone's personal information. Under 18? You'll need a guardian's OK for door-knocking. Teens knock in pairs with an adult lead in sight, in daylight, and nobody goes inside anyone's home.

Getting in

Not up for walking? Run the check-in table in the park, or text neighbors from a bench. Every role counts as a shift.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • Oviedo holds regular city elections on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November every year; terms are two years, and the seats up in 2027 are Mayor and Council Member Group 1.

    Source: cityofoviedo.net

  • That rule puts Oviedo's 2027 election on Tue, Nov 2, 2027.

    Source: cityofoviedo.net

  • Seminole's city elections are nonpartisan. In cities that elect at large, like Oviedo, all voters registered within the city limits can vote in each contest.

    Source: voteseminole.gov · Source: voteseminole.gov

  • Florida vote-by-mail requests made before the Nov 3, 2026 general election ended Dec 31, 2026.

    Source: flsenate.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
